# A. Tower Domino Tilings

## How to find it

Build the one-row mask transition matrix and exponentiate it.

## Correctness

Matrix multiplication composes consecutive row transitions; binary exponentiation therefore represents exactly `H` rows.

## Complexity

`O(2^(3W) log H)` with dense matrices.

# B. Connected Cell Sets

## How to find it

Store canonical labels for open frontier components and reject premature component disappearance.

## Correctness

Labels encode exactly future-connectable components. A vanished component cannot meet future cells; the closure rule is therefore necessary and sufficient for one final component.

## Complexity

Exponential in width and polynomial in height.

# C. Terminal Steiner Network

## How to find it

Merge terminal submasks at a vertex, then relax locations with multi-source Dijkstra.

## Correctness

Every transition joins connected structures, and splitting an optimum at its last merge yields a represented transition.

## Complexity

`O(3^k n + 2^k m log n)`.

# D. Nice-Decomposition Independent Set

## How to find it

DP over selected active-bag vertices through leaf, introduce, forget, and join nodes.

## Correctness

Introduce checks all newly visible edges; forget is safe by decomposition connectivity; join combines independent subtrees and subtracts duplicated bag weights.

## Complexity

Let `B = sum(2^|bag|)` over the supplied nodes. The reference uses `O(nB)` time and `O(B)` memory.
